scientific_question: Are dense Muon MLP phase chords primarily singular-value/radial motion, mixing inside the occupied singular frame, or rotation of the expansion subspace?

scope.execution: direct foreground diagnostic on Y400 GPU1; no training, queue, watchdog, callback, or PRO6 execution

method.subspace_rotation_residual: delta - U U^T delta V V^T
method.global_scale: projection of singular-value motion onto the phase-start singular-value vector
method.aggregation: phase-delta-energy-weighted across all layers and phases

interpretation: Dense Muon does not mainly learn MLP channel norms or singular values. It mostly changes orientation: 98.16 percent of c_fc and 99.32 percent of c_proj phase-chord energy is in mixing plus expansion-subspace rotation.

The c_proj result directly explains why scalar/channel gain and initialization repairs cannot close the gap: only 0.68 percent of its phase motion changes singular values, and almost all of that is a global scale.

The existing bilateral c_proj chart targets the correct kind of motion in principle because its hidden-side rotation acts on the same expansion-input row space that carries 73.51 percent of dense c_proj motion.

The earlier inverse-paired c_fc/c_proj and independent pre-GELU oracles already showed that adding c_fc frame motion does not materially improve the relevant function, so this result is not authorization to relaunch that falsified structure.
A fixed random affine tangent and a generic random quadratic chart remain misaligned; neither should be repeated.
decision.next_required_diagnostic: Project every selected dense c_proj phase chord onto the exact identity Jacobian of the production two-hidden-stage/four-output-stage bilateral fixed-FHT Cayley chart. Report total and component-specific recovery before choosing a new structure. Use direct foreground polling and no training.

limitations: This decomposes one optimizer trajectory, not the global low-loss solution manifold.
Near-degenerate singular values can redistribute diagonal versus in-frame mixing, although occupied-frame total versus residual rotation is invariant to basis changes within the degenerate subspace.
Energy fractions do not by themselves prove that an optimizer can select or traverse a chart direction.
The result does not establish that c_fc and c_proj use one shared raw rotation; earlier evidence shows raw directions remain layer- and matrix-specific.
